title: Mai hoon abbas
body:
mai hoon abbas mere dar pe tum aise aana
naam mera hai zamane ko adab sikhlana
<<DIVIDER>>
nange paaon hai chale saahibe meraj yahan
aisi nalain ke dastaar bhi rakh kar jaana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
baab e hitta se bada dar hai dar e maula hussain
sajda karte huwe darwaze se andar jaana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
matami saff mein khade ho ya namazi saff mein
kisi halqe mein bhi halke na nazar tum aana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bahot sheh ko pasand aise bashar ka aana
wo jo aaya hai yahan jod ke aana aana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gunehgar to phir hurr si nidamat laana
phir mera kaam hai hazrat se tumhe milwana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr mein haazir o naazir hai imame masoom
ibne zehra ko kabhi peet nahi dikhlana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye na ho hujron mein hi waqt guzar jaaye tamaam
tum watan se yahan aaye ho haram bhi aana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere sufre pe milegi tumhe jannat ki ghiza
yahan behlol bhi kha lete hai daana daana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad utha haath jo mazloomon par
maine raj'at mein qalam karna hai har wo shaana
naam mera hai zamane ko...
mai hoon abbas mere...
author: Mir Sajjad Mir
